messages:
debbie (Support): FYI customer Brightline opened a compliance ticket — they ran a search and are still getting results for objects supposedly archived and past TTL. Ticket #BR-12345. They attached a sample ID list and a screenshot.

maria (Support): I pulled the ticket. Delete API returned 202 when they called it last week, storage shows tombstone in object metadata for a subset, but search returns items. Can we triage? @kevin @oliver

retention-bot: Retention job run: 2026-03-16T02:10:23Z — batch processed 78,432 objects, errors: 2

kevin (Eng-SRE): Quick look at scheduler logs: I see HSM/KMS timeouts around 02:10:23 for shard-7, several `HSM_UNAVAILABLE` and `KMS_DECRYPT_TIMEOUT`. Might explain partial tombstone application. Sample log:```[2026-03-16T02:10:23Z] delete-scheduler shard-7 ERROR HSM_UNAVAILABLE key=rnf-archive-2026 attempt=1```

maria (Support): Repro steps customer ran for a single id (they gave these):```curl -X GET "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/search?q=user:brightline+status:archived" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"``` and a delete call they did earlier:```curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/delete" -d '{"ids":["obj_8f3b"],"policy":"archive"}'```

oliver (Security): If HSM failed during the purge, tombstone writes to storage might be incomplete. But search should respect tombstone markers — this smells like index rehydration or a delayed index eviction where a reindex job wrote entries back from archived storage. Need KMS/HSM audit and scheduler traces. Also: preserve these objects immediately for legal hold until we confirm. @maria mark ticket as preservation=on.

kevin (Eng-SRE): I pulled the KMS audit: there was a key rotation event for `rnf-archive-2026` at 02:05:17Z that triggered a transient auth failure window 02:05:20-02:12:10Z. Scheduler retried and some deletes were marked partial. Plan to export affected audit logs.

maria (Support): Customer wants ETA and proof of deletions for compliance. Legal asked to escalate. Marking as security/compliance escalation.

oliver (Security): I'll open an incident and run a targeted re-run of the purge on the affected object ids and then force an index eviction for the search shards that reported the hits. I'll also request full KMS/HSM logs. Please don't run any destructive mass jobs until we export logs.

retention-bot: Incident created: I-2026-482. Severity: P2. Assigned: oliver, kevin.

kevin (Eng-SRE): Proposed action plan (ETA 4-6h):
1) Export KMS/HSM audit logs for 02:00-03:00 UTC (in progress)
2) Re-run purge batch for affected ids with `force_tombstone=true` (throttled)
3) Reindex affected search shards and run an index eviction pass
4) Provide audit export + signed confirmation to customer/legal
I can start step 1 now. Will throttle purge to 50 qps and monitor CPU/GPU and search latency.

maria (Support): I'll update ticket BR-12345 with interim message: "We are investigating, preservation is active, expect resolution within 6 hours. We'll provide audit logs and confirmation when complete."

debbie (Support): Customer replied: they can wait but need a written timestamped confirmation once deletes are confirmed for compliance.

oliver (Security): We'll provide the exported logs and a statement. Question for infra: any objections to running the purge replay on prod during the low-traffic window at 03:00 UTC? Risk is bounded but will add load on indexers.

kevin (Eng-SRE): No objections. Will run replay throttled to 50 qps and keep circuit breakers in place. Will notify SRE on-call if latency > 200ms.

maria (Support): Thanks. I'll coordinate with Legal and send the customer the compliance note template once we have logs.

debbie (Support): :thumbsup:
